data.description: Extend the Adashi formal design for the standard-agent-workflow goal based on docs/design-extension-standard-agent-v1.md and the read-only audits of deepseek-harness and chatshell-desktop/agent. Store the v1 executable node catalog (input, model_call, agent, tool, condition, parallel, approval, output, wait, completion with typed ports and configuration contracts), the v1 built-in tool matrix with approval classes (read/search/list/grep/edit/write/shell/python/todo/web_search/web_fetch/subagent/MCP), the approval flow (approval.requested → approval.resolved, single-use, durable), the workflow library contract (catalog CRUD, seeding, default), and the standard agent workflow UML (input → model_call → agent → output → wait with the inner turn/step loop). Record the v1 in-process execution note for the desktop runtime honestly. Output: stored UML artifacts uml.system.standard_agent_workflow_v1 and uml.system.executable_node_catalog_v1 plus updated descriptions for aworkit.capability_host.tool_runtime and aworkit.desktop_ui.workflow_editor, or the equivalent documented extension if the design-write surface is unavailable, with the document kept in docs/design-extension-standard-agent-v1.md.
